calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-21-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Helen Sorep-Matley.
Petitioner: Singhui Zou, present in pro per for self and with Co-Petititioner/Minor's Mother: Yuping Li, both are present as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Meiqi Zou.
Cantonese Interpreter: Vicky Sinn, also present with the Petitioners.
Petitioners and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of an adult and of a minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of an Adult to: Eric Xinghui Zou, and Change of Name of a Minor to: Maggie Meiqi Zou.
Decree signed in open court.
